title: Saputara in a Day — The Classic Circuit

stops.note: Be in place 20 min before sunrise
Context for everything else you'll see
Buy Warli directly from the artists
Ride up before the pre-sunset rush
Claim a railing spot 40 min before sunset on weekends

day_notes.note: Everything sits within ~5 km of town — an auto or own vehicle covers it easily. Lunch at the lakefront or hotel belt; carry a layer for the post-sunset chill.

notes: Works year-round; in monsoon swap Sunrise Point's mist lottery for a longer museum-and-lake morning.
